about: A further BBMP officer email list supplied directly by the user, in the same session as data/gba-department-directory.json (which was extracted from cited official sources and is confidence HIGH). Kept in a SEPARATE file rather than merged into that one because the two sources sometimes disagree, and the disagreement itself is worth preserving rather than silently resolved by whichever file happened to be read last.
howReconciliationWorks: Every entry that matches an existing HIGH-confidence official email exactly (e.g. comm@bbmp.gov.in, eic@bbmp.gov.in) was left OUT of this file entirely — it carries no new information.

'reconciliation.type: near_duplicate' — the email looks like a spelling/naming variant of an official one already on record (e.g. cemajorroads@ vs the official cemajroad@). Recorded as an ALTERNATE email on the existing contact, never as a second competing contact.

'reconciliation.type: conflict' — a genuine factual disagreement with the official extraction (e.g. this list asserts ceelectrical@bbmp.gov.in exists; the official extraction explicitly found no head-office electrical mailbox in any cited source). Recorded with verification_status PENDING and both values kept in internal_notes, for a human to resolve in /contacts — never silently decided in code.
No 'reconciliation' field at all — a genuinely new post/address with no official-directory analog. Inserted as a new contact.

entries.notes: jchealth@bbmp.gov.in was already known from the official e-mail directory, but only as a note under the Chief Health Officer entry — it never got its own contact row. This is that gap being filled.

reconciliation.note: Official directory's Projects entry uses department mailboxes ceproj1@ through ceproj5@bbmp.gov.in, not individually mapped to one post-holder. ceprojects@ (singular) may be a newer consolidated address for the same wing — recorded as an alternate on the existing Projects contact rather than a second one.
Same post as the official Road Infrastructure / Major Roads entry (cemajroad@, no trailing 's') — a one-letter spelling variant, not a second mailbox.

The official extraction explicitly found NO head-office electrical mailbox in any cited official source — only zonal Executive Engineer (Electrical) addresses. This list asserts ceelectrical@bbmp.gov.in exists. Recorded but flagged PENDING rather than trusted outright, since it has no citation of its own.

Ambiguous against the official Road Infrastructure entry (cemajroad@) — 'Infrastructure' may be the same wing under a broader name, or a genuinely separate post. Not clearly a duplicate, not clearly new; flagged PENDING rather than guessed either way.
